loaded.row: ADP record released under the composed load, last

H-ADP.ordering: an ENTITY_AVAILABLE carries the grandmaster in force when it is built: after a grandmaster change, the first ENTITY_AVAILABLE carries the new one (Milan v1.2 5.6.3.5.7; IEEE 1722.1-2021 6.2.2.16)

loaded.row: an ENTITY_AVAILABLE behind the adp ring, its bucket refilling (observed)

H-DISC.ordering: discovery records are applied in their arrival order: a bound talker's ENTITY_DEPARTING then ENTITY_AVAILABLE leaves its sink discovered, so the sink's PROBE_TX_COMMAND follows the ENTITY_AVAILABLE (Milan v1.2 5.6.4.5.1, 5.6.4.5.3, Table 5.54)

loaded.row: an ACMP command behind the owed input

H-ACMP.ordering: the commands of one controller are answered in their arrival order, the owed responses first in first out (MAILBOX_SPLIT.md, ACMP service latency)

loaded.row: AECP record released under the composed load, last

H-AECP.ordering: every face value a response promises is committed before that response (ARCHITECTURE_HW_SW_SPLIT.md section 1; Milan v1.2 5.4.5.2; IEEE 1722.1-2021 7.5.2): a lock, clock source or identify change commits the face block between the command's receive commit and its response

loaded.row: SET_NAME fan-out under the composed load

H-NOTIFY.ordering: the successful command's response is committed before any of its notifications (Milan v1.2 5.4.5.2; IEEE 1722.1-2021 7.5.2; FR_NFR.md 3.4.1)

H-COUNTERS.ordering: a descriptor's counter pushes to one recipient leave at least 1 s apart at the wire, and a change while the push is held is coalesced into one later push (Milan v1.2 5.4.5.2, Table 5.22)

loaded.row: MAAP record released under the composed load, last

H-MAAP.ordering: the talker DA gate is published before the allocation is reported to the CSR window (maap_mbx.c, range; Milan v1.2 4.3.3.1): every report the core makes follows its interface's DA_GATE publication

loaded.row: SRP record released under the composed load, first

H-SRP.ordering: the adopted Domain is published (SR_DOMAIN) before the MRPDUs that carry it (srp_mbx.c, change_domain; MAILBOX_SPLIT.md, contract 2.2): every MRPDU committed after an adopting Domain record follows its interface's SR_DOMAIN publication with ADOPTED set
